policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Botswana visa-free visits
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance says Slovene citizens do not need a visa to enter Botswana.
conditions: This is the named Slovene ordinary-passport entry baseline. Passport validity, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Kosovo visa-free visits
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance says Slovene citizens do not need a visa to enter Kosovo.
conditions: A valid passport is the baseline for holders of older non-biometric Slovenian identity cards. Serbia-route controls, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Tunisia visa-free visits
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance says Slovene citizens do not need a visa to enter Tunisia.
conditions: The stated ordinary Slovene-passport rule requires a passport valid for at least six months from entry. Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free visits
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA's current Ukraine guidance says Slovene citizens need no visa for stays up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: This rule covers a 90-days-in-180 ordinary visitor stay. Security, border operations, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's official consular schedule expressly names Slovenia among countries not requiring a visitor visa.
conditions: The official schedule gives a maximum stay of three months. It is a named Slovenia rule, not an inference from Panama's separate third-country-document exemption.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board lists Slovenia as eligible for a visa obtained on arrival.
conditions: The named Slovenia entry says the visa is obtained on arrival and gives a 40 JOD fee; it is not reclassified as eVisa merely because Jordan separately offers electronic services.
Entry point, passport validity, onward travel, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's Special Branch makes tourists from European countries eligible to obtain a visa on arrival at Dhaka; this includes Slovene ordinary-passport holders.
conditions: This is the named European-country tourist category for a single-entry arrival visa at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport, for a maximum of 30 days.

Bangladesh says the immigration officer issues the visa after reviewing compliance; required travel documents, funds and final admission remain separate. Work, residence, special passports and third-country-document routes are excluded.
